function.name: calculate_bmi

message.content: In December, Los Angeles typically enjoys mild weather. The average high is about **68 °F (20 °C)**, while the average low dips to roughly **48 °F (9 °C)**. Overall, the mean daily temperature hovers near **58 °F (14 °C)**.
